entries.title: Responsive 16:9 news photos & smart list thumbnails
entries.detail: News story photos now frame naturally in 16:9 aspect ratio without distortion or letterboxing, plus compact right-aligned thumbnails in list mode.

entries.title: Article photos now show the whole picture
entries.detail: News cards now shrink article photos to fit without cutting off the sides or top and bottom.

entries.title: Like comments, see how many there are
entries.detail: Discuss now shows how many comments a story has. Open it and tap Like on a comment — no signup.

entries.title: Discuss opens under the story
entries.detail: Tapping Discuss expands a comment box right under that article — you stay on the feed. No signup, Anonymous is fine.

entries.title: Incognito Mode Support
entries.detail: Safely guarded all client storage and cookie preferences for smooth incognito browsing.

entries.title: Top Stories Image Card Default & View Switcher
entries.detail: Top Stories homepage now defaults to featuring rich article photography with a 1-tap List vs Cards layout switcher.

entries.title: Real Article Featured Thumbnails
entries.detail: News cards now display real featured article images extracted from RSS media enclosures, YouTube videos, and OpenGraph metadata.

entries.title: List & Thumbnail Card Layout View Toggle
entries.detail: Added a 1-tap view switcher (Compact List vs Thumbnail Cards) across Top Stories, Intersection, MyFeed, and Topic pages.

entries.title: A full month of network updates
entries.detail: The shared Updates panel now keeps 31 days of releases from News, Finance, Tools, and Images.

entries.title: Contextual ScamCheck safety callouts
entries.detail: Embedded plain-English ScamCheck warnings on news search and category pages.

entries.title: Simplified News navigation & section tabs
entries.detail: Added Top Stories section tab and clarified Intersection (Trends) & My Feed navigation options for intuitive browsing.

entries.title: Read/seen markers now cover the whole site
entries.detail: The Read marker now also appears on Top 10 by platform (the main Intersection grid) and Consensus source links, which were missing it before. Topics you've opened now show a Seen marker anywhere they're linked, too.

entries.title: News now matches the Yoyosup look
entries.detail: News now uses the same calm teal accents, compass mark, navigation styling, and coordinated light and dark themes as the rest of Yoyosup.

entries.title: See which stories you already read
entries.detail: Opened headlines now show a clear Read marker on Intersection, Curious Pulse, MyNews, topics, and journalist pages. Your history stays in this browser.

entries.title: Next 20 stories are easier to find
entries.detail: Daily Intersection now shows the next-20 control above the headlines as well as at the end of the list.

entries.title: Deploy smoke checks dozens of topics
entries.detail: Every news deploy now verifies preferred-source headlines for ~40 popular topics across Conservative, Balanced, Liberal, and default filters.

entries.title: MyNews shows Conservative headlines again
entries.detail: Fixed empty topic cards: stories come from your preferred outlets (Gateway Pundit, Breitbart, Just the News, and more), with Load more on each card.

entries.title: Curious Pulse: load 20 more stories
entries.detail: Scroll past the first 20 on the home feed and keep browsing the full consensus list.

entries.title: Load more headlines on Daily Intersection
entries.detail: Browse preferred-source headlines 20 at a time, with your Conservative / Balanced / Liberal filter applied.

entries.title: More conservative news sources
entries.detail: Conservative mode pulls Zero Hedge, Just the News, Gateway Pundit, RSBN, and other outlets from your source list.
